name: baddie-fitting-room-purple-shorts-selfie
image_purpose: Social media outfit post and fitting-room lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity smartphone mirror selfie in a small fitting-room or restroom interior.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long voluminous dark-brown wavy hair, curtain bangs, lighter highlights, medium-tan skin, a floral tattoo on the right forearm, and a gold clover-motif bracelet. She wears a loose white T-shirt with black collar trim and vivid purple fitted athletic shorts, holding a white smartphone with a marble-pattern case.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical mirror-selfie framing from thighs upward. The subject is angled slightly away while turning toward the mirror, holding the phone at chest height with a relaxed confident posture. Include textured beige wallpaper, a dark speckled granite bench, pink tumbler with straw, car keys, and light square floor tiles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse overhead fitting-room light with subtle shadows beneath hair and chin, neutral-to-warm color temperature, casual self-focused social-media atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Standard smartphone lens look, vertical portrait, sharp subject and immediate background, realistic hair strands, skin pores, fabric weave, subtle digital grain, natural color and no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fidelity vertical smartphone mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with long voluminous dark-brown wavy hair, curtain bangs, lighter highlights, medium-tan skin, a floral tattoo on her right forearm, and a gold clover-motif bracelet. She wears a loose white T-shirt with black collar trim and vivid purple fitted athletic shorts, holding a white smartphone with a marble-pattern case. She stands in a small fitting room with textured beige wallpaper, a dark speckled granite bench, a pink tumbler with straw, car keys, and light square floor tiles, angled naturally toward the mirror with a relaxed confident baddie aesthetic. Soft diffuse overhead lighting, realistic skin pores and fabric texture, standard smartphone lens, vertical portrait, and authentic social-media realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, invented logos, low resolution, blur
